name: 一日一冊の読書チャレンジ
prompt:
Edit reference 1 with only a small geometry correction. Preserve the same clean layout, all Japanese text, progress state, colors and original images. This is not a new redesign.

Keep the page and every UI surface pure white with no pale tint fills. Keep the thin neutral timeline/card borders, green Day 1 check, white Day 2 card with a green outline and empty square, and flat forest-green “聞く” button. Keep “読む” white with a thin neutral outline. Do not introduce cream, mint, blush, gray or green tinted surfaces, gradients, glows or shadows.

Use reference 2 as the exact position guide on a 390×680 canvas: title x=16/y=8, subtitle x=16/y=48; day cards x=16/y=134 and x=266/y=134; both book images x=16/y=196 and x=266/y=196 at 170×258, with the second clipped at the right edge; trophy heading x=16/y=502 and description x=232/y=504; trophy strip x=16/y=548 at 358×58; bottom actions at x=16/y=624 (110×44) and x=136/y=624 (238×44), ending y=668 with 12 px bottom margin. Preserve the 390 px viewport crop. The current candidate’s subtitle sits slightly below its anchor and its action row is slightly high; align those carefully.

Place references 3, 4 and 5 as the exact unchanged book-cover and trophy media. Do not redraw, alter, recolor, crop or overlay them. Preserve the full strings “朝の読書習慣”, “5日間のチャレンジ”, “1日目”, “2日目”, “達成のトロフィー”, “読み進めて獲得しましょう”, “読む” and “聞く”. Day 1 is complete; Day 2 is current and not complete. Keep the design compact, legible and otherwise identical to reference 1.

Return the component only, with no phone frame or app chrome.
reviewNotes: Pure-white UI surfaces remain; the exact trophy artwork includes a visible opaque cream backing that conflicts with the no-tint preference. Minor vertical drift remains after one correction; correction limit reached.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
